# Well Rigged

> Well Rigged celebrates endurable, buy-it-for-life products through independent reviews and hands-on testing of durable gear, vehicles, and everyday items.

Founded by Don Longworth, Well Rigged provides in-depth product reviews and durability analysis across categories including vehicles, outdoor gear, lighting, footwear, and clothing. The site emphasizes long-term real-world testing, including field validation in West Africa, to identify products built to last.
